2610.04905.title: ScopeSAE: Model-Scope Feature Discovery with Interpretable Layer Selection
2610.04905.paper_summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are a central tool in mechanistic interpretability. However, existing SAEs are primarily trained per layer. The modeling subspace is therefore fixed by layer identity, independent of which token-layer states actually drive each prediction. We argue that this constraint contributes to several limitations observed in layer-wise SAEs, including low feature utilization, high dictionary redundancy, and features that lack direct behavioral grounding. In this paper, we propose ScopeSAE, which selects the modeling subspace per token by attributing each prediction to its most influential token-layer state via normalized gradient-based attribution, and learns features over the resulting prediction-relevant subspace. Empirically, ScopeSAE yields an effect we term reconstruction-better-than-original. Written-back reconstructions of the SAE produce lower next-token cross-entropy than the original activations, an outcome that, to our knowledge, has not previously been reported for SAEs. Through interventional analyses and a KL fine-tuning counter-experiment, we show that this effect is attributable to ScopeSAE's prediction-relevant subspace itself rather than to architectural changes. ScopeSAE further improves effective feature count, interpretability, utilization, and dictionary redundancy over existing layer-based baselines, suggesting that choosing the SAE modeling subspace by predictive relevance leads to more useful and behaviorally meaningful features.
2610.04905.paper_summary_zh: 稀疏自編碼器（SAEs）是機械解釋性中的一個核心工具。然而，現有的SAEs主要是按層訓練的。因此，建模子空間是由層的身份固定的，與實際驅動每個預測的標記-層狀態無關。我們認為這一限制導致了層級SAEs中觀察到的幾個限制，包括低特徵利用率、高字典冗餘以及缺乏直接行為基礎的特徵。在本文中，我們提出了ScopeSAE，它通過將每個預測歸因於其最具影響力的標記-層狀態，選擇每個標記的建模子空間，並通過歸一化的基於梯度的歸因來學習在結果預測相關子空間上的特徵。實證結果顯示，ScopeSAE產生了一種我們稱之為重建優於原始的效果。SAE的寫回重建產生的下一個標記交叉熵低於原始激活，這一結果據我們所知，在SAEs中尚未被報導過。通過干預分析和KL微調對照實驗，我們表明這一效果歸因於ScopeSAE的預測相關子空間本身，而不是架構變化。ScopeSAE進一步改善了有效特徵數量、可解釋性、利用率和字典冗餘，相較於現有的基於層的基準，這表明通過預測相關性選擇SAE建模子空間會導致更有用且行為上更有意義的特徵。
